en.headline: Couple found unconscious after swimming off Tuen Mun’s New Coffee Bay
en.dek: A 23-year-old man and his 20-year-old wife, both Pakistani holders of Hong Kong identity cards, were pulled from the sea near the shark net on Friday evening and remain in critical condition at Tuen Mun Hospital.
body: Police received a report at about 8.16pm on Friday that a man and a woman were in difficulty in the water near the barbecue area at New Coffee Bay in Tuen Mun. A woman was first brought ashore by members of the public and was already unconscious. Fire services personnel later located the man in the sea; he was also unconscious when recovered.

Both casualties, identified as a 23-year-old man and a 20-year-old woman who are husband and wife and hold Hong Kong identity cards, were rushed to Tuen Mun Hospital for emergency treatment. Their condition was critical. Officers said the pair had been playing in the water near the shark-prevention net, roughly 10 to 15 metres offshore, when the woman began to struggle and called for help in English. The man entered the water in an apparent attempt to assist her.

No lifeguard service was operating at the beach at the time. The Leisure and Cultural Services Department had displayed banners stating that lifeguard services were suspended and advising the public not to enter the water for safety reasons. Police from Tuen Mun division are investigating the circumstances of the incident.

zh.headline: 屯門新咖啡灣夫婦嬉水遇溺 雙雙昏迷送院
zh.dek: 一對持香港身份證的巴基斯坦裔夫婦周五晚在新咖啡灣防鯊網附近遇溺，20歲妻子及23歲丈夫均陷入昏迷，送往屯門醫院時情況危殆。
body: 警方周五晚上約8時16分接報，指屯門新咖啡灣燒烤場附近海面有一男一女遇溺。女子率先被市民救起時已失去意識，消防其後在海中尋獲男子，同樣陷入昏迷。
兩名事主分別為23歲男子及20歲女子，兩人為夫婦，均持有香港身份證。他們被送往屯門醫院搶救，情況危殆。初步調查顯示，兩人當時在離岸約10至15米的防鯊網附近嬉水，女子突然遇險以英語呼救，男子隨即落水試圖施救，其後兩人一同遇溺。
事發時泳灘並無救生員當值，康樂及文化事務署已掛起橫額，列明暫停救生服務，並勸喻市民為安全起見切勿下水。青山警區正調查事件起因。
